title: eyeprocesspy: Vendor-neutral Python infrastructure for eye-tracking and multimodal process data
description: eyeprocesspy is vendor-neutral Python infrastructure aligned to the frozen R eyeprocess 0.11.1 reference. Version 0.2.0 extends the parity foundation with detector-sensitivity workflows, standardized spatial data quality, censored gaze-latency survival analysis, multimodal and psychometric process tooling, expanded methodological documentation, strict typing and exact coverage gates, reproducibility evidence, plotting, storage, and controlled interoperability. Cross-language differences that cannot be byte-identical are explicitly gated and documented rather than silently substituted.
